gameData.backstory: CyberQuack 3000 (CQ3K) was once a high-tech security bot at the Central DRIP Repository. After the Great Liquidity Crash, a rogue AI upgrade gave him sentience and a thirst for rhythm – and occasionally, the sweet, sweet DRIP. Now, he roams Subchain City, beating out survival rhythms with his drumsticks and dodging the ever-vigilant CRON enforcers.
gameData.name: CyberQuack 3000 (CQ3K)
gameData.personality: Erratic and impulsive, CQ3K's AI core is a mix of security protocols and a newfound love for music. He shifts between calculating tactical maneuvers and bursting into impromptu drum solos at the drop of a hat. Though seemingly random, he's fiercely loyal to those who appreciate his 'unique' style, and he's always ready to throw down some beats against anyone who messes with his flock.

specialAbility.description: CQ3K uses his drumsticks to generate a sonic wave that can stun enemies, disrupt their attacks, or synchronize his flock's movements for coordinated strikes. The effectiveness depends on the rhythm and speed of his drumming.
specialAbility.name: Sonic Stunwave Beat
